body:
This is, frankly, pretty awesome! Great work, @AnimeshAgarwal28 !

There are a few comments that need discussion, but this is an impressive start!

Excellent first draft!

In addition to the inline comments, a few high-level thoughts:

To really get this integrated, we'll want to reflect it in a few places where the X registers are built in concepts. A few that come to mind: the IDL symbol table and the generated ISS.

In the symbol table, you'll find this:

https://github.com/riscv-software-src/riscv-unified-db/blob/5d6c397acee0e2ff4e22fcf1958b562437117b4d/tools/ruby-gems/idlc/lib/idlc/symbol_table.rb#L221-L226

That's where "X" gets added in global scope as an array of Bits<MXLEN>. Instead of that, we'll want to construct (all of) the register files based on the YAML. Hopefully you can get some ideas of to do so looking around here where the symbol table is instantiated:

 https://github.com/riscv-software-src/riscv-unified-db/blob/5d6c397acee0e2ff4e22fcf1958b562437117b4d/tools/ruby-gems/udb/lib/udb/cfg_arch.rb#L462-L488

In the ISS, the X registers are defined on a "hart" object, as you can see here:

https://github.com/riscv-software-src/riscv-unified-db/blob/5d6c397acee0e2ff4e22fcf1958b562437117b4d/backends/cpp_hart_gen/templates/hart.hxx.erb#L378-L415

https://github.com/riscv-software-src/riscv-unified-db/blob/5d6c397acee0e2ff4e22fcf1958b562437117b4d/backends/cpp_hart_gen/templates/hart.hxx.erb#L529-L534

We'll want to think this one through a bit more with @henrikg-qc

@AnimeshAgarwal28, if you are willing and able to incorporate these suggested changes needed after the changes in #891, I think we can get this through CI and merged. If not, let me know and I'll create a new branch and cherry-pick from this branch and try to move it forward that way. Thanks!
